summary: The E-Rate program is vital to rural libraries across Upstate New York. In our small and rural communities, libraries often provide the only reliable access to high-speed internet on budgets that are often less than $100,000. Residents depend on their local library to apply for jobs, complete schoolwork, access telehealth services, and connect with essential government resources.
